card.name: Linking words in anticholinergic interaction text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, the, e.g.,, -induced) just before a list of anticholinergic-type effects such as urinary retention, constipation, xerostomia or bradycardia. Seen in drug interaction sections.

modes.label: 'of' after risk
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'may increase risk' in anticholinergic interaction warnings, before urinary retention.
modes.example: of the diuretic as needed. Anticholinergic Drugs Clinical Impact: The concomitant use of anticholinergic drugs may increase risk<< of>> urinary retention and/or severe constipation,

modes.label: 'e.g.,' before effects
modes.description: The 'e.g.,' after cholinergic blockade, before a list of side effects like xerostomia.
modes.example: UXARIN ER is used concomitantly with anticholinergic drugs. Additive adverse effects resulting from cholinergic blockade (e.g<<.,>> xerostomia, blurred vision

modes.label: Other linking spots
modes.description: Other connecting words inside drug-effect phrases, such as 'the' before sphincter of Oddi or '-induced' after pyridostigmine.
modes.example: The opium in belladonna and opium suppositories may cause spasm of<< the>> sphincter of Oddi. O
